command:start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }'); base=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null) || { echo "cannot tell where this task branch started: no 'gnomish: task started' commit and no origin/main"; exit 1; }; oversized=$({ git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM "$base" -- packages/client/src; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard packages/client/src; } | sort -u | while read -r file; do [ -f "$file" ] && lines=$(wc -l < "$file") && [ "$lines" -gt 300 ] && echo "$file: $lines lines"; done); [ -z "$oversized" ] || { echo "$oversized"; echo "these files exceed the 300-line hard cap - split them, see .claude/rules/process-invariants.md"; exit 1; }

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$change/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $change/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$change"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$change/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $change/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: Traceability missing on changed tests: tasks.md says 'every new or changed test, step file and feature carries `fix-day-track-handle-overlap-and-end-of-day`', and the acceptance criteria require tests to reference the requirement they implement. These changed files carry no reference to this change: packages/client/src/model/dayTrack.test.ts (new track-end cases 1439/1379/1499 and the 18:59 key moves, FR1–FR3; header only names add-time-sliders-to-location-cards and set-home-location-and-show-differences), packages/client/src/presenter/dayTrack.test.ts (maxMinutes 1439, FR3), packages/client/src/views/shared/DayTrack.input.test.tsx (bar-box mocks and the new it.each 'press left of/right of the bar' cases, FR4; header only names add-time-sliders-to-location-cards), packages/client/src/views/shared/DayTrack.legacy.test.tsx, packages/client/src/views/shared/LocationRow.test.tsx, packages/client/src/views/shared/dayTrackFixture.tsx, and the step/world files packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/steps/time_selection_legacy_tap.steps.tsx, packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/steps/timeSelectionWorld.tsx and packages/client/src/test/features/home_location/steps/homeLocationWorld.ts. Add a header such as `// Verifies FR1, FR2, FR3 of fix-day-track-handle-overlap-and-end-of-day` (FR4 for the view tests), matching the existing header lines.

packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/time_selection_e2e.feature:74: the tag line reads `@add-time-sliders-to-location-cards @NFR-A1 @M9 @fix-day-track-handle-overlap-and-end-of-day`, so this change's tag has no requirement ID after it. Task 5.3 says to 'add `@fix-day-track-handle-overlap-and-end-of-day @NFR-A1` above "No accessibility violations with tracks"', and antipatterns.md says 'If the reference is not explicit, it does not exist'. Append `@NFR-A1` after the change tag, as time_selection_moment.feature:46 does for `@NFR-P1`.

findings.message: packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/steps/time_selection_select_time.steps.tsx is 220 lines. tasks.md says 'File size: every file stays under 200 lines' and task 5.1 says 'If the steps file passes 200 lines, move the new scenarios' steps into a helper next to it.' The new outlines 'The right end reaches the last minute of 23- and 25-hour days' and 'Keys around the track end' (lines 184-219) were not moved into a helper (e.g. selectTimeSteps.ts).

packages/client/src/test/features/time_selection/steps/timeSelectionWorld.tsx, edited by task 5.2, is 214 lines, against tasks.md 'every file stays under 200 lines' and CLAUDE.md 'Files must stay under 200 lines'. Move a helper (e.g. dayBoundsOf) out to bring it under 200.
packages/client/src/views/shared/DayTrack.input.test.tsx, edited by task 4.1, is 202 lines, against the same 'every file stays under 200 lines' rule.

DayTrack.input.test.tsx:88-93: the it.each name 'should select the track end for a press %s the bar' also covers the 'left of' case, which selects fraction 0 (the start of the reference day). The H1 glossary entry defines **Track end** as 'the last minute of the reference day … the right end of a day track', and .claude/rules/glossary.md says 'A name that carries a glossary concept under a different word is a bug'. Rename the case by its real outcome, e.g. 'should select the nearest end of the day for a press %s the bar'.
